verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्तस्तु कृष्णेन धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। व्यासमामन्त्र्य मेधावी ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by Krishna, Yudhishthira, the of Dharma, gifted with great intelligence, saluted Vyasa and said these words:

verses.sanskrit: यदा कालं भवान्वेत्ति हयमेधस्य तत्त्वतः। दीक्षयस्व तदा मां त्वं त्वय्यायत्तो हि मे क्रतुः॥२॥
verses.english: Do you cause me to be initiated when the proper hour, as you truly know, come for that rite. This my sacrifice entirely depends on you. son

verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              अहं पैलोऽथ कौन्तेय याज्ञवल्क्यस्तथैव च। विधानं यद्यथाकालं तत्कर्तारो न संशयः॥३॥
verses.english: Vyasa said Myself, O son of Kunti, and Paila and Yajnavalkya, shall, undoubtedly, achieve every rite at the proper time.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्र्यां हि पौर्णमास्यां तु तव दीक्षा भविष्यति। सम्भाराः सम्भियन्तां च यज्ञार्थं पुरुषर्षभ॥४॥
verses.english: The rite of initiating you will be performed on the day of full moon belonging to the month of Chaitra. Let all the necessaries of the sacrifice, O foremost of men, be got ready.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वविद्याविदश्चैव सूता विप्राश्च तद्विदः। मेध्यमश्वं परीक्षन्तां तव यज्ञार्थसिद्धये॥५॥
verses.english: Let Sutas well-versed in the science of horses and let Brahmanas also possessed of the same learning, select, after examination, a worthy horse in order that your sacrifice may be completed.

verses.sanskrit: तमुत्सृज यथाशास्त्रं पृथिवीं सागराम्बराम्। स पर्येतु यशो दीप्तं तव पार्थिव दर्शयन्॥६॥
verses.english: Loosening the animal according to the injunctions of the scriptures, let him wander over the whole Earth with her belt of seas, showing your effulgent glory, O king.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवः पृथिवीपतिः। चकार सर्वे राजेन्द्र यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना॥७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Thius addressed (by the Rishi), Yudhishthira, the royal son of Pandu, answered, 'So be it!' and then, O monarch, he accomplished all that that utterer of Brahma had said.

verses.sanskrit: सम्भारश्चैव राजेन्द्र सर्वे सङ्कल्पिताऽभवन्। स सम्भारान्समाहृत्य नृपो धर्मसुतस्तदा॥८॥
verses.english: All the articles necessary for the sacrifice, O king, were duly procured. The royal son of Dharma, gifted with immeasurable soul, having procured all the necessaries, inforined the Island-born Krishna of it.

verses.sanskrit: न्यवेदयदमेयात्मा कृष्णद्वैपायनाय वै। ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा व्यासो धर्मात्मजं नृपम्॥९॥
यथाकालं यथायोगं सज्जाः स्म तव दीक्षणे। स्फ्यश्च कूर्चश्च सौवर्णो यच्चान्यदपि कौरव॥१०॥
verses.english: Then the highly energetic Vyasa said to the royal son of Dharma, “As regards ourselves, we are all prepared to initiate you in view of the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र योग्यं भवेत्किञ्चिद्रौक्मं तत्क्रियतामिति। अश्वश्चोत्सृज्यतामद्य पृथ्व्यामथ यथाक्रमम्। सुगुप्तं चरतां चापि यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि॥११॥
verses.english: Let the horse also be loosened today, for wandering on the Earth, according to the ordinances of the scriptures. Let the animal, duly protected, wander over the Earth.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्फ्यः काष्ठखड्गः स चात्र सौर्वणं कूर्चम् आसनार्थं कुशमुष्ठिः सोप्यत्र सौवर्णः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              अयमश्वो यथा ब्रह्मन्नुस्तृष्टः पृथिवीमिमाम्। चरिष्यति यथाकामं तत्र वै संविधीयताम्॥१२॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said Let arrangements be made by you, O twiceborn one, about loosening this horse for enabling it to wander over the Earth at its will.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं पर्यटन्तं हि तुरगं कामचारिणम्। कः पालयेदिति मुने तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति॥१३॥
verses.english: You should, O ascetic, say who will protect this horse while roaming over the Earth freely according to its will.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              इत्युक्तः स तु राजेन्द्र कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्। भीमसेनादवरजः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥१४॥
जिष्णुः सहिष्णुर्धृष्णुश्च स एनं पालयिष्यति। शक्तः स हि महीं जेतुं निवातकवचान्तकः॥१५॥
तस्मिन् वस्त्राणि दिव्यानि दिव्यं संहननं तथा। दिव्यं धनुश्चेषुधी च स एनमनुयास्यति॥१६॥
verses.english: In him are all celestial weapons, His body is like that of a celestial in its powers of endurance. His bow and quivers are celestial. He will follow this horse.

verses.sanskrit: स हि धर्मार्थकुशलः सर्वविद्याविशारदः। यथाशास्त्रं नृपश्रेष्ठ चारयिष्यति ते हयम्॥१७॥
verses.english: He is well-versed in both Religion and Profit. He is a master of all the sciences. O foremost of kings, he will, according to the scriptures, cause the horse to roam and graze at its will.

verses.sanskrit: राजपुत्रो महाबाहुः श्यामो राजीवलोचनः। अभिमन्योः पिता वीरः स एनं पालयिष्यति॥१८॥
verses.english: son This mighty-armed prince, of dark colour, is endued with eyes resembling lotus petals. That hero, the father of Abhimanyu, will protect the horse,

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनोऽपि तेजस्वी कौन्तेयोऽमितविक्रमः। समर्थो रक्षितुं राष्ट्रं नकुलश्च विशाम्पते॥१९॥
सहदेवस्तु कौरव्य समाधास्यति बुद्धिमान्। कुटुम्बतन्त्रं विधिवत्सर्वमेव महायशाः॥२०॥
verses.english: Gifted with great intelligence and fame, Sahadeva will, O you of Kuru's race, duly attend to all the relatives who have been invited to your capital.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तु सर्वे यथान्यायमुक्तः कुरुकुलोद्वहः। चकार फाल्गुनं चापि सन्दिदेश हयं प्रति॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by the Rishi, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, viz., Yudhishthira, performed every injunction duly and appointed Phalguna to attend to the horse.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              एह्यर्जुन त्वया वीर हयोऽयं परिपाल्यताम्। त्वमर्हो रक्षितुं ह्येनं नान्यः कश्चन मानवः॥२२॥
ये चापि त्वां महाबाहो प्रत्युद्यान्ति नराधिपाः। तैर्विग्रहो यथा न स्यात्तथा कार्यं त्वयानघ॥२३॥
आख्यातव्यश्च भवता यज्ञोऽयं मम सर्वशः। पार्थिवेभ्यो महाबाहो समये गम्यतामिति॥२४॥
verses.english: You should also invite them all to this sacrifice of mine. Indeed, O mighty armed one, go forth but try to establish friendly relations with them.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा च धर्मात्मा भ्रातरं सव्यसाचिनम्। भीमं च नकुलं चैव पुरगुप्तौ समादधत्॥२५॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having said so to his brother Savyasachi, the righteous-souled king Yudhishthira commanded Bhima and Nakula to protect the city.

verses.sanskrit: कुटुम्बतन्त्रे तदा सहदेवं युधां पतिम्। अनुमान्य महीपालं धृतराष्ट्रं युधिष्ठिरः॥२६॥
